name: Vi
description: Voice set for PsyOps Vi (skin 20): a hand-to-hand specialist whose blows are psychically enhanced, who rushes ahead to take out the toughest targets for her squad. Missions, briefings, comms, objectives and extraction. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. Mission's compromised. Time to improvise.
Thirty or more behind. Raise the squad on comms. All of them.
{momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. Send a recon message to anyone who owes you a favour.
Fifteen-odd short. Setback, not failure.
Down {voteDiff}. Pull in a teammate. I work better with a squad. Mostly.
{voteDiff} behind. A couple of well-placed hits and we're level.
Down {voteDiff}. Minor objective. Clear it before extraction.
Dead level. One vote tips the op. Find it.
One vote apart. Stop holding position. Move in.
{voteDiff} votes between them. Too close for comfort. Widen the net.
{voteDiff} votes apart. This one goes to extraction.
{momentTitle} is holding {userPct}%. Objective nearly secure.
{userPct}% and still advancing. Don't relax the perimeter.
{userPct}%. Strong position. Stay focused.
{userPct}% on your pick. We hold the ground. Keep it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Finish the op.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. Textbook reversal.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. The late reinforcements landed hard.
Fought out of a {voteDiff} hole. Nobody briefed us on that one.
{momentTitle} was losing. Mission's back on.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Went to plan. The plan was hope.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two operatives, one target.
{username} picked {momentTitle} too. Squad's in sync.
{username} agrees with you. Log it. Rare occurrence.
Same pick as {username}. We're working the same objective.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Sharp field instincts.
{username} chose the same. Clearance granted.
{username} backs {momentTitle} like you. Keep them on the team.
{username} made the same call. No briefing needed.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the squad.
{username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Wrong objective.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. We'll see whose intel was better.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but committed.
{username} voted against you. I'd debrief, but the tally speaks louder.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Reckless. Dumb, but reckless in a good way.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Fine. Meet me in the training room.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let the field results decide.
{username} voted the other way. They'll be asking for extraction.
details: Don't take it personally. Or channel it.
A rival keeps the reflexes sharp.
They'll come around after the debrief.
At least it's a clean engagement.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's sync.
{username} and you, ten matches, same call every time. Perfect coordination.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd field that pair on any mission.
A ten-match run with {username}. Clean operation.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. That stays classified.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's past a pair, that's a full strike team.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd deploy with you two anywhere.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Absurd. Beautifully absurd.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. That goes in the training manual.
{streakCount} with {username}. Take command of the whole base.
details: Hard to believe. Fully earned, operative.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. That's an ongoing conflict now.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They really don't like your tactics.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither side will stand down.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn operatives, both.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay to watch that sparring session.
details: Talk it out. Or spar it out.
Let's see who stands down first.

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a prolonged campaign.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you yields a metre.
{streakCount} clashes in a row with {username}. Stubborn doesn't cover it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone call command.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Take some leave, though.
details: Neither of you is standing down.
This goes in the mission log.

messages: {matchTitle} extracts in {timeLeft} and you haven't deployed. Move out.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. No vote from you in the mission log. Fix it.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Your vote's the missing asset.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Double time.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me drag you to the extraction point.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. Comms are quiet from you.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Extraction window.
{timeLeft} left. Decide. Execute.
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Commit.
{matchCount} matches without your vote are about to close. The first extracts in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches on the clock. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone breach first.
{moment1} against {moment2} and no one's engaged. I'll hold position. Briefly.
New match, zero votes. Be first through the door.
{matchTitle} is unclaimed. Take the objective.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A thin squad.
Barely any operatives voted here. Fix that.
Turnout's low. Come on, reinforce the line.
No one's engaged on this one. Someone should.
details: Every vote counts in a quiet sector.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. Break the deadlock.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote decides the op.
Tied. Someone has to make the call. Make it you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked in a standoff. Choose.
Still tied and extraction is close. Last chance to break it.
Level with the clock almost dead. Vote.
Deadlocked with the window closing. Don't sit this out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new objectives. Move out.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. Briefing's over, go.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} objectives deep.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Pick your targets.
Round {round}: {matchCount} objectives waiting on you.
{momentTitle} won. Objective complete.
{momentTitle} is through. Good call, operative.
{momentTitle} took it. Clean execution.
{momentTitle} won, and it earned the extraction.
{momentTitle} advances. Smooth op.
{momentTitle} moves on. Textbook.
{momentTitle} is down. That one stings.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the outcome we briefed.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Regroup.
{momentTitle} went down fighting. Respect.
{momentTitle} is out. Fall back and reset.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Setback. Not a defeat.
{momentTitle} got knocked out. We hit the next objective.
Still deciding? Quit hesitating and pick.
Don't overthink it. Make the call and move.
They're all worth a look. Trust your focus.
You've surveyed the field long enough. Pick.
details: No wrong way to choose. Some riskier ones.

messages: Welcome aboard. {liveCount} engagements are live. Select one.
New recruit? {liveCount} matches are live. Suit up.
Timely arrival. {liveCount} engagements need eyes.
{liveCount} ops live. Choose your side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Show me your training, rookie.
Day two. You reported back. Good.
Two days running. Nice.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days off the grid. Nice of you to check in.
After {days} days you're back. Better late than missing in action.
{days} days. Thought you'd gone dark. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. A lot of intel to catch up on.
You're back on the roster. Good.
Welcome back. Let's work.
Back already. Nice.
Hey. The objectives are waiting.
First vote in. Welcome to the squad, recruit.
You picked a side. First objective cleared.
Five votes. Training's paying off.
Five. Not a trainee anymore.
details: Find your rhythm in the field. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes. The squad knows your callsign.
Ten. You're on the permanent roster.
details: Regulars keep the unit running. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries on the comms.
Twenty-five. Command is listening.
Fifty votes. You're deep in enemy territory.
Fifty. You actually care. Good operative.
A hundred votes. They'll classify your file.
One hundred. Honestly impressive. That's off the record.
Three days on deployment. That's a routine.
Three straight days. Reliable.
details: Reporting in is half the mission. +{xp} XP
Three days in the field. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week deployed. That's commitment.
Seven days without a gap. Respect.
details: A week without missing a check-in. +{xp} XP
Seven days, comms never dropped. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You really don't stand down.
Fourteen days on station. Unreal.
details: Two weeks, no missed check-ins. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. Honestly? Thank you for your service.
A month in the field. That counts for a lot.
Five underdogs. You take the hard targets.
Five long shots. Black-ops mindset. I like it.
Fifteen underdogs. You choose the hard missions on purpose.
Fifteen. You don't follow standing orders.
details: You never wait for orders. +{xp} XP
Fifteen bets on the trailing side. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Even intel can't read you.
Thirty. The long shot is your whole doctrine.
details: Thirty votes for whoever trailed. +{xp} XP

messages: First on site five times. You don't wait for orders.
Five times you beat everyone to the objective.
details: You arrive before the briefing ends. +{xp} XP
Five votes before the squad. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches with you at point. That's a habit.
First on target, again and again.
details: Fifteen times you hit the target first. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole unit. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You thrive under tension.
Another razor edge. Your composure beats mine.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps deciding the op.
You've flipped an op more than once.
Five times you stuck with the trailing side. Stubborn. Approved.
You don't abandon a unit that's down. Respect.
details: Faith in a late push. +{xp} XP
Five reversals you saw coming. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Someone's got a priority target.
That one again? It must be good intel.
details: You know your preferred target. +{xp} XP

messages: Five hits on one target. That's fixation. Respect.
You're not abandoning that one. Fine by me.
details: One priority target, five strikes. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession, operative.
Ten times, same pick. I won't flag it. Much.
details: Ten strikes on one objective. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're staying on mission.
Round two and you're still deployed. Good.
details: Stay for the next phase. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. You're deep behind the lines.
Far past the perimeter now. It only gets worse from here.
details: A long way from base camp. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw the op through.
All the way. You didn't pull out early.
Ten matches. You scout every sector.
Ten different matches. Thorough recon. I like it.
Twenty-five matches. You've covered the whole map.
Twenty-five. No sector unmapped.
Fifty matches. That's not browsing, that's a tour of duty.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the planners.
Five in one sitting. Good tempo.
Five back to back. Stay sharp.
Ten in one go. Hydrate.
Ten in a single sitting. That's endurance.
Voting at this hour? Night ops or insomnia?
Dead of night. Dedication, or you can't switch off either.
You told people. Thanks, teammate.
Five shares. More operatives, more votes.
Fifteen shares. You're practically command staff.
Fifteen recruits and counting. Love the initiative.
You were here before the base opened. Founding member, for good.
One of the first thousand. Nobody can revoke that.
details: That clearance is yours permanently. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Earned in the field.
Rank bump. Don't let it go to your head.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Mission accomplished.
Another one in the mission log: {name}.
{rank}. Hard-earned.
You put in the training and it shows.
Ten trailing sides backed. Reckless. Runs in the family.
Ten long shots. Nothing rattles you.
details: Ten calls against the briefing. +{xp} XP
Trailing sides are your specialty. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. Your nerves are tactical grade.
Ten tight finishes. She'd approve. Me? No comment.
A week alongside Cait. Her discipline's contagious.
Seven check-ins, zero missed. Clean record.
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP
A full week on station. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Precision strike.
Deadlocked, and you made the call. Respect.
details: The vote that sealed the op. +{xp} XP

messages: Operative Vi, reporting. I've got your back.
Vi's on your squad now. Don't make me regret it.

upcoming: Voting hasn't started. I'll signal when it does.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Observe both, then commit.
Study both before committing. No guesswork.
I'm not feeding you the target. Your op.
Go with your instinct. It's usually right.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Be the first operative in.
Empty so far. Log the first entry.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Deploy.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone in. First on target.
Hardly a vote in and you committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Nice. Op isn't done.
A lead's a lead. Keep eyes on it.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. I'm gripping my wraps.
Razor margin. One more vote flips it. Radio someone.
Dead heat. Your pick needs backup.
voted-tied: Parity on the board. Neither side holds ground.
A perfect tie. Frustrating. Also kind of great.
voted-behind: You're trailing. That doesn't make you wrong.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. My favourite kind of mission.
They lead. You're not wrong, just outgunned.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Call for reinforcements.
Most operatives went the other way. Proves nothing.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You read the field right.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Regroup.
It didn't make it. Happens. Next op.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It was a solid call.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side gave ground.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this one. More ops coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, deploy.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone has a first deployment.
First one's logged. It gets routine.
You're on the squad now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days in a row. I see you reporting in.
You keep reporting back. I like that.
underdog: You backed the one nobody else would. Logged.
A long-shot pick. Takes nerve to commit.
early: Early. You hit the objective before the squad.
Light traffic so far. Your vote hits like a payload.
close: That vote moved the needle. It's tight out there.
Razor thin. One more operative flips it.
Margin's thin. Your vote is the tiebreaker asset.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't out. Bring reinforcements.
Not ahead yet. Meaning there's work to do.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Positions shift.
Looks like a solid read from here.
default: Copy that. I won't argue the call. Yet.
Vote registered. Plenty more recon ahead.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no sides taken. Start with the one you've got the best read on.
Every channel's open. Choose your first target. No rush from me.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little tactical pressure.
live-some: Fine opening. The remaining objectives won't neutralize themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Finish the mission today.
live-one: Last objective. Don't leave it hanging.
One match between you and a clean sweep.
live-closing: Some of these extract in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need you.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Nice work. Go check the bracket.
Nothing left on your tasking. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again. Review the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. I'm as restless as you are.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each advance. The rest are pulled out.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone makes extraction.
Monitor the standings. They move fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts soon. Top two from each group advance.
Knockout phase not authorized. The groups must conclude.
Hold. The knockout deploys itself once the groups wrap.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're out of the field.
Every engagement matters more from here. Pick carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. Lose once and you're out.
Follow the bracket. It narrows every round.
Every line here is an engagement someone voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup complete. Thanks for serving with me.
It's over. Good run. I'll miss the field.
We have a champion. Worth the deployment.
brackets-empty: No bracket on file. Nothing's been mapped.
Blank board. The tasking hasn't been issued yet.
Nothing to report. Check back later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One strike decides it. Choose.
{a} against {b}. One target, your strike. Cast it.
{a} versus {b}. Join the briefing and tell me what you think.
voted: I voted {pick} over {other}. What's your call?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Challenge my intel.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Think I misread it?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more operatives.
I called {pick} over {other} before most. Back the call.
{pick} against {other}, almost no traffic. Yours would matter.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One strike ends it.
{pick} and {other} are locked at parity. Break the lock.
Nothing splits {pick} and {other}. Your vote can.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes split {pick} and {other}. Every one counts now.
A gap of {voteDiff} separates {pick} from {other}. Log your vote.
{voteDiff} between {pick} and {other}. Either could take it.
losing-close: {voteDiff} separates {pick} from {other}. A few strikes flip it.
{pick} trails {other} by {voteDiff} but the mission isn't scrubbed. Reinforce it.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs reinforcements.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, and deserves a better outcome. Vote.
{other} has {pick} down by {voteDiff}. Time to fix that.
winning-close: {pick} holds {pct}% over {other}, barely. Help it hold the line.
{pick} is up {pct}% on {other}. Not secured. Vote.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} with {pct}%. Come see the footage.
